name: paper-collage-reveal
title: Paper Collage Reveal
description: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

variables.label: Panels
variables.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.

variables.label: Paper tone
variables.description: Paper color per scrap from the reel palette: cream is light (--fg), kraft grey (--muted); mixed seeds light, grey and dark (--surface) scraps.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.
